sampling_dimensions.sampling_space_description: A representative sampling space for the United States population described in the supplied demographic data (population estimate 331 million). Reported age, gender, race and ethnicity, income, geography, marital status, education, religion, party-identification, and public-opinion percentages are retained where supplied. Several source figures are rounded or internally inconsistent, and many characteristics are not measured as mutually exclusive categories. For those characteristics, separately reported percentages are not forced into a false single distribution. Where requested dimensions have no population prevalence data, balanced weights are provided for coverage rather than presented as measured U.S. prevalence. Individual characteristics should be sampled independently only where appropriate; demographic and cultural dimensions should be cross-checked for plausible combinations.
